structuredContent.name: tenants.create-tenant
structuredContent.description: Create a new tenant with an identifier, a display name and a description (null for none). Only a global administrator can create tenants. The tenant starts active with no members and no configuration; an identifier that already exists is rejected.

TenantId.description: Identifier of the new tenant: 1 to 256 ASCII letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting and ending with a letter or digit. It is case-sensitive and cannot be changed later.

Description.description: Free-text description of the tenant. The key is required; send null for no description.
